source.title: Northern Whig, 4 June 1927, p. 8 ("Antrim Rural Council"); Belfast News-Letter, 4 June 1927, p. 8 (rural council results: Antrim)
source.publisher: Northern Whig (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names and votes read on the block images of the Northern Whig results of 4 June 1927 and checked against the Belfast News-Letter and Irish News of the same date

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 2 June 1927 in Cogry and Rashee only (the queue's nominal date of 26 May is the statutory date, not the poll). The other twenty-two divisions were declared elected without a contest, Antrim Urban returning two members (Ballymena Observer, 20 May 1927, p. 9). No party labels are printed. Beggs, J.P. (old member), 177; Todd (new member), 145; majority 32.
correctionNote: Checked on the page image of the Belfast News-Letter, 4 June 1927, p. 8 (w8-review, Nov 2026): the News-Letter prints 'William Andrew Todd (new), 145' against William John Beggs's 177, majority 32 (recorded), so the name and votes stand; the nomination lists (Northern Whig, 13 May 1927; Ballymena Observer, 20 May 1927) print him Robert Andrew Todd.
